interactions.summary: Jiang affirms the student's story of stopping an unjust punishment and classifies it as selfless generosity or sacrifice rewarded by communal joy.
A participant offers the memory of first arriving in New York and feeling the shock of total newness and difference.
Another participant names the joy of finally sleeping after IB exams, and Jiang reframes that happiness as the release of long-held tension.
Participants give examples of finally getting a long-desired dog and returning home after studying abroad, and Jiang classifies them as wish fulfillment and homecoming.

speaker_notes.note: The New York memory is fragmentary in ASR, but the emotional point is clear: happiness appears as first contact with radical novelty.

claims.claim: Jiang treats the memory of defending someone from unjust punishment as a happiness rooted in selfless generosity and sacrifice.
Jiang identifies one kind of happiness as relieve-and-release: the joy that comes when accumulated anxiety and tension are finally discharged.
He classifies finally getting the desired dog as wish fulfillment, where a long-standing desire is satisfied and that satisfaction becomes a happy memory.
Returning home after a long absence is presented as a distinct happiness type, tied to re-entry, recognition, and belonging.
claims.temporal_scope: Audience example treated as a lecture category on 2026-06-20.

signature_moments.moment: Happiness can be the bodily snap when months of pressure suddenly leave you.
signature_moments.why_it_matters: It shows Jiang turning everyday memories into a conceptual map for what Heaven will later mean.

signature_moments.moment: A happy memory is a wish finally catching up with reality.
signature_moments.why_it_matters: This becomes one of Jiang's building blocks for translating paradise into ordinary human experience.

glossary_terms.definition_or_usage: Jiang's phrase for happiness as the release of prolonged nervous tension.
Jiang's category for the happiness that comes when a long-desired thing finally arrives.

chronology_notes.note: This packet builds Jiang's preparatory taxonomy of happiness before he maps Heaven onto continuous intensified versions of these states.

uncertainty_notes.note: The New York example is ASR-noisy, so later public prose should preserve only the broad theme of exhilaration at entering a radically new world.
